entries.title: CHEST: LATERAL
entries.notes:
14X17 LW       SID: 72" 
CR: ⟂ to MCP at T7
Breath: Suspend at end of 2nd full inspiration

IR Top: 1.5-2” above shoulders
Coll: 1" border around skin line

Pos: Rest arms above head or hold bar (IV stand in front)

Eval: 


Arm or its soft tissues not overlapping the superior lung field

Costophrenic angles and portions of the pulmonary apices

not obscured by the arms and shoulders

No rotation: 

**Hila in the center of the radiograph 

Superimposition of the ribs posterior to the 

vertebral column

Sternum in profile 

Trachea visible in the midline

Long axis of the lung fields shown in vertical position,

without forward or backward leaning

Open thoracic intervertebral joint spaces and 

intervertebral foramina, except in patients with scoliosis

Sharp outlines of heart and diaphragm

Pulmonary vascular markings from the hilar 

regions to the periphery of the lungs




Notes: Left Lateral preferred
